file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression library that sets up OmegaConf resolvers, loads environment variables via dotenv, and configures Hydra for distributed training entrypoints.

file_nodes.name: activations_dataset.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines QKVDataset, a PyTorch Dataset that loads pre-saved safetensors files containing per-layer query, key, and value activations along with attention metadata for RL agent training.

file_nodes.name: pad_collate.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides a DataLoader collate function that pads variable-length QKV tensors along the sequence dimension and assembles a batch-level attention mask for use in distributed training.

file_nodes.name: train_agent_sampler_distributed.py
file_nodes.summary: Main distributed RL training entrypoint for the KVP sampler agent: orchestrates multi-GPU setup, data loading, RLOO trainer construction, checkpointing, evaluation, and S3 upload via the RLOOTrainingRecipeDistributed class.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the metrics subpackage that re-exports MetricsManager to make it accessible at the kvcompression.metrics namespace.

file_nodes.name: _metrics_manager.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements MetricsManager, a distributed-aware training metrics tracker that aggregates scalar values across ranks, logs to W&B, generates matplotlib plots, manages run/figures directories, and tracks the best checkpoint path.

file_nodes.name: infinite_distributed_sampler.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides InfiniteDistributedSampler, a DistributedSampler subclass that loops forever over the dataset without stopping at epoch boundaries and supports resumable state via state_dict/load_state_dict.

file_nodes.name: training_checkpointer.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements TrainingCheckpointer and the ResumeInfo dataclass, providing full checkpoint lifecycle management: saving, loading, best-model tracking, old-checkpoint pruning, random-state serialization, and distributed rank-0 broadcast of checkpoint paths.

file_nodes.name: attention_utils.py
file_nodes.summary: Core attention utility library providing functions to materialize full attention weight matrices, generate causal attention masks, and expand KV caches for grouped-query attention (GQA) heads across the kvcompression framework.

file_nodes.name: compressor.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements the KVCompressor context manager and LayerHeadCompressionConfig dataclass, providing the primary user-facing API for configuring and applying per-layer/per-head KV cache compression strategies via monkey-patched attention hooks.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package barrel for the kv_cache subpackage, re-exporting CompressibleKVCache and CompressionStrategy (and related classes) as the public surface of the module.

file_nodes.name: compressible_attention.py
file_nodes.summary: Contains the monkey-patched MHA forward pass and setup_cache functions that replace standard torchtune MultiHeadAttention behavior with a compressible variant that routes KV updates through CompressibleKVCache and applies per-head compression strategies.

file_nodes.name: compressible_kv_cache.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines CompressibleKVCache, a KVCache subclass that stores per-head compression strategy objects alongside K/V/Q tensors and implements compress() to selectively evict cache entries using strategy-derived boolean masks.

file_nodes.name: compressible_mha_layer.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines CompressibleMultiHeadAttention, a thin wrapper around torchtune MultiHeadAttention that adds a reset_cache() method and is the target class whose forward/setup_cache methods are monkey-patched by the hooks layer.

file_nodes.name: compression_strategy_protocol.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines the CompressionStrategy Protocol and its concrete implementations: DummyCompressionStrategy (keep all), RandomCompressionStrategy (random eviction), and PressCompressionStrategy (delegates to a BasePress scorer for importance-based eviction).

file_nodes.name: constants.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines project-wide constants used across the kvcompression package, providing a single source of truth for shared literal values.

file_nodes.name: costs.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements the core KV cache eviction cost computation, measuring the attention loss incurred by evicting cache entries at various cache sizes via batched tensor operations.

file_nodes.name: kvsorting_env.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines KVSortingEnvironmentV2, the RL environment in which per-head agents learn to rank KV cache entries by iteratively selecting tokens to evict and receiving rewards based on oracle-computed attention cost.

file_nodes.name: base_reward_strategy.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines the abstract RewardStrategy base class that all reward implementations must extend, specifying the compute_reward interface for deriving scalar rewards from oracle cost results.

file_nodes.name: basic_strategies.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides the FutureAttentionAucNormalizedReward concrete strategy that extracts the AUC-normalized future attention cost from oracle results as the RL reward signal.

file_nodes.name: oracle.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements the Oracle class that materializes full attention weights from keys/queries and computes ground-truth KV eviction costs, serving as the reward signal source for RL training.

file_nodes.name: utils.py
file_nodes.summary: General utility functions for the kvcompression package: model unwrapping, agent checkpoint loading, reproducibility seeding, torch-compile detection, and recursive batch-to-device transfer.

file_nodes.name: base_press.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines BasePress, the abstract base class for all KV cache eviction strategies, specifying the sort/forward interface that concrete press implementations must fulfill.

file_nodes.name: random_press.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements RandomPress, a baseline KV cache eviction strategy that assigns random scores to cache entries for shuffled eviction order.

file_nodes.name: sampler_agent_press.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements SamplerAgentPress, the primary RL-based KV cache eviction press that loads a per-head sampler agent from a checkpoint (local or S3) and uses it to score cache entries for eviction.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package init for kvcompression.tools that re-exports AgentRegistry and assignment generator utilities for external consumers.

file_nodes.name: agent_registry.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides AgentRegistry, which discovers, validates, and resolves checkpoint paths for per-head RL agents stored in an S3 bucket under a structured group/sweep/layer/head hierarchy.

file_nodes.name: assignment_generator.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides generate_composites and write_composites_file utilities that build composite agent assignment configurations mapping each transformer layer/head to its best available checkpoint path.

file_nodes.name: s3_utils.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides S3/fsspec utilities for the kvcompression framework: filesystem construction, directory upload, file download, path mapping, remote secret loading, and remote folder listing.

file_nodes.name: base_agent.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines the abstract BaseAgent class that all KV cache RL agents must implement, providing shared logic for action sampling, masked softmax selection, and entropy-based exploration.

file_nodes.name: kv_sorting_agent.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements KVSamplingGroupedQueryAgent, a neural network agent that scores KV cache entries for eviction by combining projected key, value, positional, and query-aggregated features through an MLP, supporting grouped-query attention (GQA).

file_nodes.name: base_env.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines the abstract BaseEnvironment interface that all KV cache RL environments must implement, exposing reset, step, and get_valid_actions methods.

file_nodes.name: compute_advantages.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides two utility functions for computing RLOO-style advantages from terminal rewards: a loop-based version and a vectorized version, both supporting optional advantage normalization.

file_nodes.name: rloo_gumbel_terminal_trainer.py
file_nodes.summary: Extends RLOOTerminalTrainer with a Gumbel-noise-based trajectory collection strategy that replaces stochastic categorical sampling with Gumbel-top-k sorted ordering, enabling differentiable or diverse rank-based eviction decisions.

file_nodes.name: rloo_terminal_trainer.py
file_nodes.summary: Core RLOO (Reward-Linked Online Optimization) trainer that manages the full RL training loop for KV cache eviction agents, including trajectory collection with sequential token eviction, policy updates with entropy regularization, EMA model maintenance, and evaluation with plotting utilities.

file_nodes.name: chunk_sampler.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines ChunkSampler, a PyTorch-compatible sampler that partitions a dataset into fixed-size sequential chunks and optionally shuffles indices within those chunks for reproducible batched data loading.

file_nodes.name: kvpress_dataset.py
file_nodes.summary: Wraps a Hugging Face dataset for KVPress preprocessing, providing tokenized chat message pairs with row-level IDs used during KV cache data generation.

file_nodes.name: unroll_and_store.py
file_nodes.summary: Entry-point script for KV cache data generation: runs forward passes on a language model while intercepting attention tensors via hooks, then saves the resulting Q/K/V tensors and generated tokens to disk (and optionally S3) for downstream RL training.

file_nodes.name: extractors.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides the ExtractAttentionTensors context manager that intercepts attention module forward calls to capture and persist per-layer, per-head Q/K/V tensors to disk during model inference.

file_nodes.name: registrar.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements low-level hook registration utilities for attaching forward hooks and monkeypatching attention modules in a torchtune-style transformer, returning context managers that clean up hooks on exit.

file_nodes.name: test_generate_with_compression.py
file_nodes.summary: End-to-end tests for the generate_with_compression function, verifying that the compressed generation matches torchtune baseline output when no compression or noop compression is applied, differs when real compression is used, and raises errors on invalid batch sizes.

file_nodes.name: test_compressor.py
file_nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for the KVCompressor component, covering forward-pass output equivalence with noop strategies, generation-level equivalence, and divergence verification when non-trivial compression strategies (RandomPress, PressCompressionStrategy) are applied.

file_nodes.name: test_patched_model_forward.py
file_nodes.summary: Tests that a model patched with a KVCompressor using a noop compression strategy produces logits numerically close to those of the unpatched model during a forward pass.

file_nodes.name: test_online_attention.py
file_nodes.summary: Test suite for online attention mechanisms, validating attention weight rematerialization equivalence, GQA (grouped-query attention) key/value expansion correctness, and edge cases for the materialize_attention_weights utility.

file_nodes.name: test_utils.py
file_nodes.summary: Shared test utilities providing deterministic tensor and model initialization helpers (fixed_init_tensor, fixed_init_model) and a base_test_model factory used across the entire test suite to ensure reproducible test setups.

file_nodes.name: .env.template
file_nodes.summary: Template for runtime environment variables covering data root path, HuggingFace model ID, S3 bucket, Weights & Biases settings, and optional torch.compile disable flag; intended to be copied to .env and sourced before running preprocessing, training, or inference scripts.

file_nodes.name: .pre-commit-config.yaml
file_nodes.summary: Pre-commit hook configuration enforcing trailing-whitespace removal, end-of-file fixing, YAML validity, merge-conflict detection, and Ruff-based linting and formatting on every commit.

file_nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
file_nodes.summary: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct (7 sections) defining community standards, maintainer responsibilities, scope of enforcement, and reporting procedures for unacceptable behavior.

file_nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
file_nodes.summary: Brief contribution guide directing contributors to read CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md before getting started; serves as the entry point for new contributors.

file_nodes.name: README.md
file_nodes.summary: Primary project documentation covering installation, dataset generation, training, and inference for the KVP (KV Policy) framework — lightweight per-head RL agents that learn to rank KV cache entries by predicted future utility for adaptive LLM eviction; includes citation, acknowledgements, and license sections.

file_nodes.name: pyproject.toml
file_nodes.summary: Python project manifest for the kvcompression package defining build system (setuptools + git-versioning), runtime dependencies (PyTorch, flash-attn, transformers, torchtune, wandb, s3fs, etc.), uv workspace source and dual PyTorch index configuration for CPU vs CUDA 12.8 platforms, and tool settings for pytest, mypy, and ruff.

file_nodes.name: .understandignore
file_nodes.summary: Ignore rules for the understand-anything knowledge graph tool, listing paths and patterns that should be excluded from analysis (e.g., binary assets, generated files, large data splits).

file_nodes.name: ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
file_nodes.summary: Credits and attribution notice listing third-party libraries, datasets, and prior work that the kvcompression project builds upon.

file_nodes.name: train.txt
file_nodes.summary: Training split index file for the RULER benchmark dataset, listing 6175 sample identifiers used to select KV cache training examples for RL agent learning.

file_nodes.name: val.txt
file_nodes.summary: Validation split index file for the RULER benchmark dataset, listing 325 sample identifiers used to evaluate RL agent performance during and after training.

file_nodes.name: preprocess_ruler.yaml
file_nodes.summary: Configuration for the RULER dataset preprocessing pipeline, specifying the model, tokenizer, data directories, chunking parameters, device settings, and KV cache generation options used to produce training data.

file_nodes.name: agent_training_setup.sh
file_nodes.summary: Shell setup script for initializing a single RL agent training job: installs system and Python dependencies via uv, then downloads only the specific layer/head KV cache data needed for training to /dev/shm for fast in-memory access.

file_nodes.name: preprocessing_setup.sh
file_nodes.summary: Shell setup script for the KV cache preprocessing stage: validates the KVCOMPRESSION_MODEL_ID environment variable, installs dependencies via uv, and downloads the target LLM from HuggingFace using torchtune.

file_nodes.name: train_single_head.yaml
file_nodes.summary: Primary training configuration for a single KV head RL agent, covering all aspects of the training loop: agent architecture, environment parameters, reward strategy, EMA, optimizer, learning rate schedule, logging, WandB integration, profiler, and final evaluation settings.

file_nodes.name: inference_demo.ipynb
file_nodes.summary: Jupyter notebook demonstrating end-to-end inference with a trained KV compression agent, walking through model loading, agent application, and evaluation of eviction quality.

file_nodes.name: download_data.py
file_nodes.summary: CLI tool for downloading KV cache training data from an S3-compatible remote store; supports selective download by layer, head, and data split, with completeness verification of the downloaded hierarchy.

file_nodes.name: agent_registry.py
file_nodes.summary: CLI commands for discovering and validating trained RL agent checkpoints stored in a remote S3 bucket, providing sweep inventory, per-agent discovery, and completeness validation against expected layer/head counts.

file_nodes.name: assignment_generator.py
file_nodes.summary: CLI tool that generates composite YAML assignment files for parallel RL agent training jobs, mapping sweep names to specific (layer, head) pairs and validating availability of required checkpoints.

file_nodes.name: cli_logging.py
file_nodes.summary: Configures Rich-based logging for the kvcompression CLI, providing a custom handler that prints colorized log records to stdout and a setup function that wires it into the root logger.

file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression data module, marking it as a Python package and providing the public surface for data loading and processing components.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression entrypoints module, marking it as a Python package that contains CLI and script entry points.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the data generation entrypoints sub-module, exposing CLI commands for dataset preprocessing and KV cache generation.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the RL training entrypoints sub-module, exposing CLI commands for agent training and evaluation.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression hooks module, marking it as a Python package for transformer attention hook implementations.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression presses module, marking it as a Python package for KV cache eviction policy implementations.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression rl module, marking it as a Python package containing agents, environments, rewards, and trainers for RL-based KV cache compression.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the RL agents sub-module, exposing the policy network implementations used to score and rank KV cache entries.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the RL environments sub-module, exposing the KV cache eviction environment used to generate rollouts during agent training.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the RL rewards sub-module, exposing reward function implementations that evaluate the quality of KV cache eviction decisions.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the RL trainers sub-module, exposing the training loop and loss computation utilities for the KV eviction agents.

file_nodes.name: policy_entropy_loss.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements the REINFORCE policy gradient loss with entropy regularization for KV cache eviction agents; reconstructs valid action masks from episode history and computes policy and entropy losses over valid episode steps.

file_nodes.name: triton_policy_entropy_loss.py
file_nodes.summary: Implements a fused Triton GPU kernel for computing the combined policy gradient and entropy regularization loss in a single pass, including both forward and backward custom autograd functions for efficient RL training.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Package initializer for the kvcompression utils module, re-exporting generation utilities for external consumers.

file_nodes.name: generation.py
file_nodes.summary: Provides token generation utilities for inference with KV cache compression, implementing a torchtune-compatible sampling function and a full autoregressive generation loop that interleaves model forward passes with cache compression steps.

file_nodes.name: scheduler_factory.py
file_nodes.summary: Defines a SequentialScheduler that chains a linear warmup scheduler with a cosine annealing scheduler for learning rate scheduling in RL training.

file_nodes.name: __init__.py
file_nodes.summary: Empty package initializer marking the tests directory as a Python package.

file_nodes.name: conftest.py
file_nodes.summary: Pytest configuration file that registers a custom 'cuda' marker, provides a session-scoped fixture to skip CUDA tests when no GPU is available, and a base model config fixture used across KV cache tests.

file_nodes.name: test_chunk_sampler.py
file_nodes.summary: Unit tests for the ChunkSampler data utility, verifying validation logic, complete dataset coverage, uneven chunk distribution, and shuffle determinism across epochs.

file_nodes.name: test_compute_advantages.py
file_nodes.summary: Parametrized tests comparing a reference loop-based advantage computation against the vectorized implementation, verifying numerical equivalence across various batch sizes, sequence lengths, and normalization settings.

file_nodes.name: test_masked_logprob_entropy.py
file_nodes.summary: Tests verifying the Triton-accelerated policy entropy loss against a naive Python reference implementation, checking forward loss values, entropy, policy loss components, and backward gradients for numerical equivalence.

file_nodes.name: test_attention_utils.py
file_nodes.summary: Tests for the materialize_attention_weights utility, verifying its output against scaled dot-product attention across combinations of causal masking, padded sequences, and explicit attention masks.

file_nodes.name: test_costs.py
file_nodes.summary: Tests for the batched_compute_cost function covering regression values, output structure, oracle ranking correctness, GQA support, padding handling, device transfer, and cost decomposition by cache size.

file_nodes.name: test_compressible_kv_cache.py
file_nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for CompressibleKVCache covering initialization, reset, update (simple, multiple, overflow, zero-length), compress (empty, target-zero, logic, invalid sizes), get_k_v_and_mask_for_attention, GQA query group extraction, query storage, and compression strategy dispatch.

file_nodes.name: test_flexattention_bfloat16.py
file_nodes.summary: Tests verifying numerical equivalence between PyTorch's flex_attention and scaled_dot_product_attention under bfloat16 precision, covering both random large-scale and small deterministic examples.

file_nodes.name: test_patched_attention.py
file_nodes.summary: Tests for patched multi-head attention equivalence, verifying that patched and original MHA produce identical outputs during prefill and decode phases, and that the compressible MHA variant behaves correctly when the cache is at capacity.
